Problem Statement:
Jack lives in the tri state area which is notorious for robberies. So as a responsible citizen of his community he has set up N baits to catch the robbers . The bait is in the form of a house containing a certain amount of money. His local community however do not have consistent funds and do not regularly supply him with money for the baits. Also , they are scared that the robbers will steal their money so they want their money back sometimes. Initially all the houses have some amount of money which will be given . Three types of events can happen :1 x y z : The community gives Z amount of money for each house from house x to house y to set up baits2 x y z: The community takes away Z amount of money from each house from house x to house y as they are scared they will lose their money. If amount of money in each house is less than Z all the money is taken away from that house and it'll become 0.3 x y : Jack wants to know what is the sum of the money from house x to house y. These three scenarios can happen multiple times, one after the other in any fashion.(For example : the order of events could be event1,event2,event1,event3 etc.)Help Jack perform the above operations and report the required answer successfully
input_spec:
The first line contains a single integer N :the number of houses he sets up as bait
The second line contains N integers denoting the initial money in all the houses
The third line contains a single integer E : the number of events that can happen
The next E lines can be either one of the three events as described in the problem statement:
1 x y z (OR) 2 x y z (OR) 3 x y
output_spec: Output a single line containing the sum of money in all houses from house x to house y for each event of type 3
